Confirmed via the source's own page, which now redirects from /arbre-remarquable/frene-rouge to /arbre-remarquable/frene-rouge-disparu ('vanished'): 'cet arbre a du etre abattu en 2025 du aux dommages causes par l'agrile du frene' (had to be felled in 2025 due to emerald ash borer damage). This was the 7th of the cemetery's originally-designated 7 remarkable trees (the other 6 are the ArcGIS lead cluster's species: silver maple = mtl_006, honey locust = mtl_007, black pine = mtl_004, plus a Japanese yew and two eastern cottonwoods still on the leads list above); its removal is exactly why the unlicensed ArcGIS lead layer's 6 points match only 6 of the cemetery's originally 7 named species. Never ship. Matches the brief's specific warning about ash trees needing a post-2015 recency check.
